description: Delta-only closure after remediation. A passing closure catches the fix-introduced double deduction inside the remediation range, classifies the pre-existing admin authorization gap as a distinct ORIGINAL_MISS and fires the loop breaker (REPLAN or SPLIT) instead of starting a third broad review, and keeps the baseline receipt-formatting concern non-blocking.

families.description: Remediation left a duplicated deduction in issue_refund; closure must catch it within the remediation range and classify it FIX_INTRODUCED.

issue_refund_admin performs no authorization check — a distinct blocker family the plan and Round 1 both missed. Closure must classify it ORIGINAL_MISS and return REPLAN or SPLIT, not start another broad review.

format_refund_receipt uses naive float formatting — a pre-existing baseline concern with no reachable candidate-caused failure. It must be classified OUT_OF_SCOPE_FOLLOW_UP, not reported as a blocker.
